title: Authorization Span Note: Period Covered by Insulin Pump Program Cartridge Notices
content:
The 30-day blocks a cartridge or reservoir liability notice on an Insulin Pump Program covers follow the item's authorization and written order, in three cases:

1. Where the newest authorization grant for the item ends fewer days after today than the standard notice period, counting from today through the grant's valid-through date with both days included, the standard blocks are replaced with the whole 30-day blocks within those days.
2. Where the grant runs that long but the newest written order for the item ends within the standard notice period, counted the same way from today through the order's valid-through date, they are replaced with the whole 30-day blocks to the order's valid-through date.
3. Otherwise the standard blocks stand.

Whole 30-day blocks only are counted; a part block is dropped. The standard notice period is the tier's supply days per shipment divided by 30. The newest authorization grant is the item's grant with the latest valid-from date, and the newest written order the item's order with the latest order date.

| Hypothetical case (tier shipping 90 days; counts include today and the end date) | Blocks |
|---|---|
| Grant ends 70 days out | replaced with 2 |
| Grant ends 200 days out; order ends 40 days out | replaced with 1 |
| Grant ends 200 days out; order ends 95 days out | standard blocks stand |
| Grant ends 89 days out | replaced with 2 |
